purpose: This table is a small reference dataset mapping airline carrier codes to their full legal names, intended to be joined with flight-level fact tables to enrich records with human-readable airline names.
usage: Join downstream flight data on the carrier code to resolve the full airline name; treat this table as static reference data with one row per carrier and no nulls to filter.
limitations: The table has only 16 rows, one per known carrier, and duplicate_row_rate of 0.0 means no deduplication logic was needed; all three Airbyte capture-metadata columns were dropped as they carried no business meaning.
